name: RevitMCPFamilyCommandSet
description: Family editor commands: create and edit Revit families (.rfa)

commands.description: Read family parameters, formulas and per-type values
Add family parameters (batch) with optional values and formulas
Set family parameter values for current, listed or all types
Set or clear family parameter formulas
Create a family type, optionally copied from another
List family forms, reference planes, levels and materials
Create solid or void extrusion in a family
Create solid or void blend in a family
Create solid or void revolution in a family
Associate form parameters with family parameters
Save the family document or save it as .rfa
List family templates (.rft) from the Revit template folder
Create a family from a template and pin it as the editing session
Open a family (.rfa, project family or active document) as the editing session
Finish the family session: save, load into project, close
